result.description:
Electrician (General) positions available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

NEPEAN Power specialises in design and manufactures high quality electrical equipment. Our products can be found throughout the Australian and international mining, construction, and industrial sectors. NEPEAN Power is also level 3 Service Providers (ASP3) for designing distribution works in NSW

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Electrician (General) based at our NSW Office. You will be responsible for electrical installation, wiring, fit out, and testing of prefabricated switchrooms, modular skids, and transportable units. The role ensures all work is delivered safely, efficiently, and to specification in alignment with project schedule. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

KEY RESULT AREAS
WHS:
Work safely using appropriate SWMS, Risk Assessments, or Safety Operating Procedures
Immediately report hazards to a supervisor or safety representative and monitor corrective actions
Take reasonable care for the health and safety of all people and the environment at work.

Key Responsibilities:
Install and terminate electrical systems in modular switchrooms, skids, and prefabricated enclosures
Interpret modular electrical schematics, drawings, and scopes of work
Carry out testing, fault finding, and pre-commissioning of modular electrical systems prior to delivery
Work with carpentry and fabrication teams to sequence tasks for efficient modular build
Ensure electrical works comply with AS3000, AS4871, and other applicable standards
Assist with installation and connection works on customer sites when required
Maintain and calibrate electrical tools, test equipment, and machinery
Provide high quality workmanship that meets deadlines, budgets, and project specifications
Complete service sheets, progress reports, and documentation to required standards
Liaise with the Leading Hand or Foreman on priorities and deliverables
Support logistics and site teams with unit handover, inspection, and client acceptance.

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:
Strong knowledge of AS3000 and AS4871
Understanding of modular construction practices
Ability to interpret modular electrical schematics and scopes of work
Fault finding and problem-solving skills
Organisational and time management skills
Flexibility to adapt to dynamic modular build requirements
Ability to work both independently and in a cross-trade team
Attention to detail and strong quality focus
Clear communication and interpersonal skills
Current Driver Licence (required)
Relevant tickets (Forklift, EWP, Confined Space) highly regarded.

Education, Qualifications, and Experience
Relevant electrical trade qualification
NSW electrical licence (or equivalent)
Preferably 4 years’ experience in installation and fit out, preferably within modular or construction industries
Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

If you believe you have the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
result.title: Electrician (General)

result.description:
Expected Salary: $40 – $45 per hour

About the role
We are seeking an experienced and qualified Roof Plumber to join our dynamic team in Hobart, TAS 7000. This is a full-time position offering the opportunity to work on a diverse range of roofing and cladding projects across residential properties. As a Qualified Roof Plumber, you will play a crucial role in delivering high-quality workmanship and ensuring all installations meet relevant building codes and industry standards. This position is based in Hobart and offers the chance to work with a reputable company that values craftsmanship and professional excellence.

Key responsibilities
Measure, cut and fit metal and other roofing materials to specifications
Measure and install all types of wall cladding

What we're looking for
Current and valid roof plumbing or plumbing qualification recognized in Tasmania
Proven experience working as a roof plumber in the residential and/or commercial sectors
Competency in reading and interpreting architectural plans and specifications
Strong knowledge of roofing materials
Proficiency with hand tools, power tools and specialized roofing equipment
Understanding of building codes, regulations and Australian standards relevant to roof plumbing
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Ability to work safely at heights and hold a current Working at Heights qualification
Strong communication skills and a commitment to customer satisfaction
Physical fitness and the ability to work in various weather conditions
Preferably, experience with modern roofing technologies and sustainable building practices

What we offer
Competitive remuneration package based on qualifications and experience
Opportunities for professional development and further training in emerging roofing technologies
A supportive work environment with an experienced and skilled team
Potential for career progression within the company
Safe working practices and provision of necessary personal protective equipment
Flexible work arrangements where possible to support work-life balance
Access to industry-leading tools and equipment

About us
We are a well-established roofing and cladding specialist based in Hobart, Tasmania. We are committed to delivering exceptional quality workmanship on every project, from new residential housing to re-roofing existing properties. With a reputation built on reliability, professionalism and customer service, we pride ourselves on employing skilled tradespeople who share our values of excellence and safety. Our team is dedicated to creating durable, weatherproof solutions that protect properties and enhance their aesthetic appeal. We believe in investing in our staff and fostering a workplace culture where skilled trades are valued and respected.

To apply now, please submit your resume, relevant qualifications and references. We look forward to hearing from you.

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a Roof Plumber?
Do you have a current Tasmanian plumbing licence?
Have you completed a qualification in building & construction?
Have you completed a qualification in building design / building design drafting?
Do you have your own tools relevant to this role?
Do you have a current hoists licence?
Do you have experience working on residential construction projects?

Position: Accountant
Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $85,000 - $95,000
Employer Name: MNI ELECTROSPARK ALL TRADES SERVICES PTY LIMITED
A.B.N. 20 143 358 963
Job Location: 10 Rosedale Avenue, Greenacre, NSW, 2190,  AUSTRALIA
Advertising Period: 28 days - 20 Jul 2026 > 17 Aug 2026

Please include Reference: J1691-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Summary

Our client MNI ElectroSpark All Trades Services Pty Limited is seeking to add an Accountant to its Greenacre-based operations. The position will support accurate financial reporting, statutory compliance, budgeting, payroll, project costing and management decision-making across a busy multi-trade services environment. The successful appointee will help strengthen financial controls, improve reporting processes and maintain reliable accounting systems as the business continues to grow.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and management reports.
- Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll processing and general ledger reconciliations.
- Prepare budgets, forecasts and financial models supporting operational and strategic business objectives.
- Monitor project costs, revenue, margins and financial performance across multiple trade contracts.
- Complete month-end processes, including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Prepare and review BAS, GST, PAYG, payroll and other statutory reporting obligations.
- Maintain accurate job costing records for labour, materials, subcontractors and individual work orders.
- Investigate financial variances and provide practical recommendations to improve profitability and efficiency.
- Develop and maintain effective internal controls protecting company assets and financial information.
- Coordinate audit requirements and respond to queries from auditors, advisers and regulatory authorities.
- Liaise with project managers regarding billing, timesheets, purchase orders and cost discrepancies.
- Maintain and improve accounting systems, reporting tools and automated financial processes.
- Monitor cash flow, outstanding invoices, supplier payments and short-term funding requirements.
- Provide timely financial insights and reports supporting management planning and decision-making.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Relevant bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in accounting, finance or a closely related professional discipline.
- At least three years’ demonstrated accounting experience, preferably within trades, contracting, project-based or multi-service business environments.
- Strong experience in preparing financial statements, management reports, budgets, forecasts, reconciliations and statutory reporting obligations.
- Practical knowledge of Australian taxation and compliance requirements, including BAS, GST, PAYG, payroll and superannuation.
- Demonstrated ability to manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, month-end processes and general ledger integrity.
- Proficiency with accounting software such as Xero or MYOB, together with advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities.
- Strong analytical skills for reviewing project costs, financial performance, variances, cash flow and operational efficiency.
- Excellent communication, organisational and stakeholder management skills, with accuracy and discretion when handling confidential financial information.

Please include Reference: J1691-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.
